name: Mobile App
summary: Plan, build, test on physical devices, and release a mobile application.

brief_fields.label: App goal and core user problem
Target mobile platforms and OS versions

phases.label: Discovery
phases.exit: Scope, target devices, and permission requirements are documented.

phases.label: UX Design
phases.exit: User flows, navigation, and screen states are reviewed and signed off.

phases.label: Build
phases.exit: Screens, native integrations, and offline sync pass automated checks.

phases.label: Device Testing
phases.exit: Core flows pass on target physical devices under varied network states.

phases.label: Store Release
phases.exit: Store metadata, privacy disclosures, and signed build pass review.

task_types.label: Screen
micro_hints: Implement layout matching responsive breakpoints for small and large phones
Wire loading, empty, and error states with accessible labels
Connect navigation routes and verify back-stack behavior

task_types.label: Platform Integration
micro_hints: Request runtime permission with clear rationale and handle denial gracefully
Integrate native capability behind a platform-agnostic interface
Verify behavior on physical hardware and record observed output

task_types.label: Offline and Sync
micro_hints: Persist pending user actions locally when network is unavailable
Replay queued updates on reconnect and resolve conflicts predictably
Verify data integrity across airplane-mode toggle and app restart

task_types.label: Test
micro_hints: Write automated tests covering primary user flows and edge cases
Execute manual smoke checklist on each target device class
Capture test run logs and verify zero critical regressions

task_types.label: Store Submission
micro_hints: Prepare signed release build with incremented version and build number
Complete store privacy questionnaire, screenshots, and release notes
Verify release candidate via closed beta track and archive submission receipt

granularity.rule: Each microtask must deliver one verifiable outcome that can be checked on a simulator or physical device.

memory_sections.label: Target Devices
memory_sections.hint: Supported OS versions, screen sizes, and physical test devices.

memory_sections.label: Permissions and Privacy
memory_sections.hint: Requested device permissions, user rationales, and data handling rules.

memory_sections.label: Decisions
memory_sections.hint: Key architecture, offline sync, and release trade-offs with rationale.
